auth.description: Argo CD JWT, from `argocd account generate-token` for a local account or from an AppProject role token. Its Argo CD RBAC policy is what bounds this Connection: a token with only `applications, get` cannot sync whatever this catalogue declares. Entered or resolved at the Connector placement and never returned to the caller
auth.name: argocd.api_token
auth.subject: app

config.help: The operator-approved HTTPS origin of this Argo CD API server, without an API path. In private deployments this resolves only at the selected local or federated Connector placement
config.label: Argo CD origin
config.name: origin

config.help: Supply this through the selected Connection's custody: local OS keychain, a wired secret provider, or satellite-local storage. The harness can write it but cannot read it back. Scope it in Argo CD's own RBAC to the projects and verbs this Connection should have
config.label: Argo CD API token
config.name: api_token

items.description: One Argo CD Application. The upstream v1alpha1Application definition carries the entire custom resource, including full Helm, Kustomize, plugin and ignore-difference configuration. This projection declares the identity, source, destination and status fields B10x promises and stops there; unlisted fields are still returned by the server.

namespace.description: Namespace the Application resource lives in, which is the Argo CD namespace rather than the destination.

destination.description: Cluster and namespace an Application deploys into. Projected from v1alpha1ApplicationDestination.

name.description: Registered cluster name, used instead of `server` when the destination names a cluster.

namespace.description: Default destination namespace for resources that do not set one.

server.description: API server URL of the destination cluster.

source.description: Where an Application's desired state comes from. Projected from v1alpha1ApplicationSource.

chart.description: Helm chart name, for a Helm repository source.

path.description: Directory within the repository, for a directory, Kustomize or Jsonnet source.

repoURL.description: Git or Helm/OCI repository URL the manifests are read from.

targetRevision.description: Branch, tag, commit or chart version this Application tracks.

health.description: Argo CD health assessment. Projected from v1alpha1HealthStatus / v1alpha1AppHealthStatus.

lastTransitionTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the health status last changed.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the health status.

status.description: Healthy, Progressing, Degraded, Suspended, Missing or Unknown.

operationState.description: Outcome of the most recent sync, rollback or terminate. Projected from v1alpha1OperationState.

finishedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the operation finished, absent while it runs.

phase.description: Running, Succeeded, Failed, Error or Terminating.

retryCount.description: Number of times the operation has been retried.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the operation started.

reconciledAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last reconciliation.

revision.description: Revision the live state was last compared against.
